description.value: Famous Yan's Restaurant is a well-established Chinese and Western cuisine destination in Salmon Arm, offering an extensive wok-based menu spanning seafood, noodle, and poultry dishes alongside a popular weekend smorgasbord. The restaurant accepts online orders and reservations, adding convenience for cyclists planning stops along the Okanagan–Shuswap corridor. Its location approximately four minutes from the highway on 21st St NE makes it accessible from major touring routes.

address.value: 880 21 St NE, Salmon Arm, BC V1E2K9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at yans.ca is fully accessible and provides authoritative contact details absent from the OSM record: address 880 21 St NE, Salmon Arm, BC V1E2K9 and phone (250) 832-3007. The OSM name 'Yan's' diverges from the website's consistent branding as 'Famous Yan's Restaurant', which is flagged as a concern. No cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; the only confirmable amenity is takeout, evidenced by the prominent 'OnlineOrder' navigation item.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Yan's' but the website consistently brands it as 'Famous Yan's Restaurant'.
Address and phone number were absent from the OSM record; both values are sourced from the website only and cannot be cross-checked against OSM data.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, operating full-service restaurant convenient to cycling routes through Salmon Arm, but none of the required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from the website. Outreach or a site visit to verify these basics would determine whether it meets WWC inclusion thresholds.
